autofish.configuration.autofishEnabled.t: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
autofish.configuration.multiRod.tooltip: Cycles through all available rods in the hotbar, moving to the next as they break.
autofish.configuration.openWaterDetectEn: In game versions above 1.16, you can only get treasure loot at open water. This will alert you when you are not fishing at open water.
autofish.configuration.noBreak.tooltip: Stop using rods with low durability before they break.
autofish.configuration.persistentMode.to: Always keep the fish hook cast whenever a rod is in hand. Checks every 10 seconds and recasts if needed.
autofish.configuration.autoTurnView.tool: Automatically turn the camera view when a fish is caught.
autofish.configuration.turnAngle.tooltip: The angle in degrees to turn the camera when a fish is caught.
autofish.configuration.turnDuration.tool: How long to hold the turned view before restoring to original position (ms).
autofish.configuration.useSoundDetection:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based §6on bobber sounds rather than the §6standard hook movement detection.
- You must be somewhat close to the hook for this to work.
- If other players' hooks are near yours, it can falsely trigger a catch!
Forces the use of multiplayer detection while in singleplayer.
This provides compatibility with third party mods.
autofish.configuration.recastDelay.toolt: Adjusts the delay between catching a fish and recasting the rod. Range: 500–5000 ms.
autofish.configuration.randomPercent.too: Add +/-% randomness to the Recast Delay. Example: 20% makes a 1500ms delay fall in 1200–1800ms. Set to 0 to disable.
autofish.configuration.reelInDelay.toolt: Add a delay for the reel-in when a fish bites the float. Set to 1 to disable this function.
autofish.configuration.clearLagRegex.too: Recast the fishing rod when this regular expression pattern is matched in chat.
info.autofish.open_water_detection.fail: §c[Autofish] The area you're fishing in is not open water!§0
options.autofish.compatibility.title: Compatibility Settings
options.autofish.reel_in_sound.title: Reel-in Sound
options.autofish.reel_in_sound.title.too: The sound event that triggers reeling in when sound detection is enabled.
Choose server sound packets or client sound playback, including local sounds.
Singleplayer requires Force Multiplayer Detection.
options.autofish.sound_distance_origin.t:
Measure the distance from the sound to the player or bobber.
Both options require your bobber to exist.
options.autofish.sound_detection_range.t: The maximum distance in blocks between the sound and the selected origin.
options.autofish.fishing_fluid.title: Fishing Fluid
options.autofish.fishing_fluid.title.too: The fluid in which the bobber is detected for fishing.
options.autofish.reel_in_count.title: Reel-in Count
options.autofish.reel_in_count.title.too: The number of consecutive reel-in attempts made after a bite is detected.
options.autofish.registry_search: Search translated name or registry ID
